🤝 Безбар’єрність — це не про потреби окремих людей, а про простір і сервіс, комфортні для всіх. Амбасадор проєкту «Рух без бар’єрів», ветеран і власник закладу харчування Федір Самбурський завітав до ресторану «МакДональдз» у Києві, щоб на власному досвіді перевірити його безбарʼєрність. «МакДональдз» в Україні послідовно впроваджує рішення, щоб ресторани були доступними для людей з різними потребами, і ділиться досвідом з іншими бізнесами. Спільно з Міністерством у справах громад, територій і внутрішньо переміщених осіб та ГО «Ліга Сильних» компанія розробила «Гайд з безбар’єрності для закладів харчування» з рекомендаціями для створення доступних просторів. 🎬 Дивіться у відео , як виглядає шлях відвідувача в закладі мережі та що з цього можуть запозичити інші бізнеси.

Ukraine is responding, with absolute justification, to every Russian strike. And I thank our Defense Forces for ensuring these responses are precise, — Volodymyr Zelenskyy. I thank all components of Ukraine's Defense and Security Forces for implementing our 'kinetic sanctions' against the aggressor. Thank you to everyone who stands with Ukraine!"

I never understood why Americans, and well, not just Americans but also others from developed countries have this insatiable thirst of individualism, in the case of North America it is slightly understandable since they have no civilization to lay their weight on, but at a point it does not limit itself to new or old societies, only about the natural pridefulness of man. I met again an old friend, he got out based on psychiatric reasons, and as we were drinking tea we were reminding ourselves of the tales from what happened and what we saw, and he reminded me of what happened at his blockpost, we got a good laugh out of it and then I felt bad. Well, this guy, a Bedouin, goes to the checkpoint with his truck - a tank and two dozen guys at arms are guarding it, one asks him to submit to inspection and the Bedouin flatly says "No.". You have to understand that this was years in the war, and the idea that somebody would say "No." to a simple thing like an inspection that would not last more than three minutes was just dumbfounded. Then my friend goes out in his tank top and his shorts and asks what's the matter, just let us inspect your truck, and the guy kept saying no, and this brought that and they argued and the guy had the intellect to say phrases like "You are not going to see the tomorrows sunlight." and "You are all going to die." To this day I am unsure of why he did it, tribal pride? Was he smuggling dildos to Israel? maybe a secret smugglers to the black flags? just why? Maybe an argument with the wife that made him unpleasant in conversation? It did not matter to my friend, who immediately left and returned with his automatic and shot him. Of course, investigation later showed this guy was no smuggler to suspicious characters, he was a local guy and belonged to so and so tribe. So we return to the main question - why do people just refuse to submit? It was not like we were asking to inspect his woman or his daughter, or we were humiliating him in some way, why do Americans argue with their cops if they were at fault or when its procedures? Why are some people completely neurotic to the concept of yielding to such basic things? I cant kick his corpse back up and ask him what he was thinking, that retard. Well, I laughed, then I felt bad about myself because it was not proper to do so, strange how after such things you feel more meek and polite towards people instead of being irritating and aggravating.
